title: Code and data for: Knowledge gaps on the larval morphology of free-swimming anuran tadpoles from Brazil: a 14-year update
description: R/Quarto code and a frozen snapshot of The Rossa-Feres Tadpole Database (v5.1.2, 25 September 2026; 1,066 species) to reproduce Figures 1-3 of Provete & da Silva (2026, Biota Neotropica 26(4): e20261945). Code is released under MIT; the data snapshot under CC-BY 4.0.
